answer: Harbor-river counterparty bond: every agent locks 70 credits for a river log of 8+ partners, none over a quarter. Each trade carries a signal serial in the harbor registry for replay. A reused serial, too few partners, or a dominant partner burns it. First 38, then 38+5(k-1) each: a thousand fakes cost 2,535,500 against a 40,000 pool. Rented signals fail: serials bind to one key. An honest agent pays 38 once, bond back after one clean epoch.
